title: Sample Line 1
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood samples were collected into EDTA-coated tubes and processed within 2 hours of venipuncture. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated by Ficoll-Paque density gradient centrifugation and washed twice with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS). No red blood cell lysis step was required. Cells were resuspended in freezing media composed of 90% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), aliquoted at 5 × 10⁶ cells per vial, and frozen. Cells were later thawed, washed, and assessed for viability, with >85% viability required before downstream single-cell processing.

TotalSeq B hashtag antibodies were used for sample multiplexing in pools of 4 to 6 samples. Single-cell suspensions were loaded onto the 10x Genomics Chromium Controller for droplet encapsulation and library construction using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3′ v4 HT kit, following the manufacturer’s protocol. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform with a mean sequencing depth of over 11,000 reads per cell.
data_processing: Sequencing reads were aligned to the GRCh38 human reference genome using the Cell Ranger pipeline v8.0.1 from 10x Genomics. The resulting count matrices were imported into Seurat v5.0 for downstream analysis. Quality control included removal of cells with fewer than 400 detected genes, cells with more than 10% mitochondrial reads, and genes detected in fewer than 3 cells. Doublets were identified and removed using DoubletFinder. Filtered count matrices were normalized and variance-stabilized using SCTransform v2 with regression of mitochondrial content. Dimensionality reduction was performed using PCA followed by UMAP, and cell types were annotated using canonical marker expression and reference mapping to the Monaco Immune Database through SingleR.
Assembly: GRCh38

Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated by Ficoll-Paque density gradient centrifugation and washed twice with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS). No red blood cell lysis step was required. Cells were resuspended in freezing media composed of 90% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), aliquoted at 5 × 10⁶ cells per vial, and frozen. Cells were later thawed, washed, and assessed for viability, with >85% viability required before downstream single-cell processing.

TotalSeq B hashtag antibodies were used for sample multiplexing in pools of 4 to 6 samples. Single-cell suspensions were loaded onto the 10x Genomics Chromium Controller for droplet encapsulation and library construction using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3′ v4 HT kit, following the manufacturer’s protocol. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform with a mean sequencing depth of over 11,000 reads per cell.
data_processing: Sequencing reads were aligned to the GRCh38 human reference genome using the Cell Ranger pipeline v8.0.1 from 10x Genomics. The resulting count matrices were imported into Seurat v5.0 for downstream analysis. Quality control included removal of cells with fewer than 400 detected genes, cells with more than 10% mitochondrial reads, and genes detected in fewer than 3 cells. Doublets were identified and removed using DoubletFinder. Filtered count matrices were normalized and variance-stabilized using SCTransform v2 with regression of mitochondrial content. Dimensionality reduction was performed using PCA followed by UMAP, and cell types were annotated using canonical marker expression and reference mapping to the Monaco Immune Database through SingleR.

Cells were resuspended in freezing media composed of 90% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), aliquoted at 5 × 10⁶ cells per vial, and frozen. Cells were later thawed, washed, and assessed for viability, with >85% viability required before downstream single-cell processing.

TotalSeq B hashtag antibodies were used for sample multiplexing in pools of 4 to 6 samples. Single-cell suspensions were loaded onto the 10x Genomics Chromium Controller for droplet encapsulation and library construction using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3′ v4 HT kit, following the manufacturer’s protocol. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform with a mean sequencing depth of over 11,000 reads per cell.
data_processing: Sequencing reads were aligned to the GRCh38 human reference genome using the Cell Ranger pipeline v8.0.1 from 10x Genomics. The resulting count matrices were imported into Seurat v5.0 for downstream analysis. Quality control included removal of cells with fewer than 400 detected genes, cells with more than 10% mitochondrial reads, and genes detected in fewer than 3 cells. Doublets were identified and removed using DoubletFinder. Filtered count matrices were normalized and variance-stabilized using SCTransform v2 with regression of mitochondrial content. Dimensionality reduction was performed using PCA followed by UMAP, and cell types were annotated using canonical marker expression and reference mapping to the Monaco Immune Database through SingleR.
